fullPassage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world, even in large cities, is still walking because of constraints on the resources needed to operate extensive transit systems. People cover long distances on foot every day and expend human energy that they can hardly spare. Walking under those conditions is an unavoidable burden that consumes productive capability. In North America and Western Europe, however, the attitude and policies are just the same: walking is efficient, healthful, and natural. We should do more of it — almost everybody agrees — and some of the current trends should be reversed. Ironically, among the most popular exercise machines in health clubs and in homes are tread-mills that simulate walking, which could be otherwise accomplished with a transport purpose on the street.

questions.passage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world is still walking because of (A) on the resources needed to operate extensive transit systems. Walking under those conditions is an unavoidable (B) that consumes productive capability. Ironically, among the most popular exercise machines are tread-mills that (C) walking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자원에 대한 제약(constraints), 피할 수 없는 부담(burden), 걷기를 모방하는(simulate) 기계.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 일치
❌ ② advantages: constraints의 반의어
❌ ③ benefit: burden의 반의어
❌ ④ eliminate: simulate와 다름

questions.passage: People cover long distances on foot every day and (A) human energy that they can hardly spare. In North America and Western Europe, however, the attitude and policies are just the same: walking is (B), healthful, and natural. Some of the current trends should be (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 일치
❌ ② conserve: expend의 반의어
❌ ③ wasteful: efficient의 반의어
❌ ④ maintained: reversed의 반의어

questions.passage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world is still walking because of constraints on the resources needed to operate ①<u>extensive</u> transit systems. People cover long distances on foot every day and ②<u>expend</u> human energy that they can hardly spare. Walking under those conditions is an unavoidable burden that ③<u>enhances</u> productive capability. In North America and Western Europe, walking is ④<u>efficient</u>, healthful, and natural.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ enhances(강화하다)는 원문 consumes(소모하다)의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ enhances: 원문은 consumes(소모하다)
✅ 나머지: 원문 일치

questions.passage: The principal transportation mode in the developing world is still walking because of ①<u>constraints</u> on the resources. People cover long distances on foot every day and expend human energy that they can hardly ②<u>spare</u>. Walking is an ③<u>avoidable</u> burden. Ironically, tread-mills ④<u>simulate</u> walking, which could be otherwise accomplished with a transport purpose.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ avoidable(피할 수 있는)은 원문 unavoidable(피할 수 없는)의 반의어로 부적절.

❌ ③ avoidable: 원문은 unavoidable(피할 수 없는)
